title: Make GrowteX Ventures site fully responsive for mobile and web

requirements.summary: Make Header component fully responsive with collapsible hamburger mobile menu, scaled logo, and 44×44px touch targets
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (<768px), the desktop nav links are hidden and a hamburger icon is shown
Tapping the hamburger icon opens a full-width dropdown menu with all nav links and CTA button
Tapping a nav link closes the mobile menu and smooth-scrolls to the target section
On desktop (≥768px), the full horizontal nav is shown and the hamburger is hidden
All tap targets are at least 44×44px on mobile
The dark agency aesthetic is preserved on all breakpoints

file_operations.description: Add mobile menu state (isMenuOpen) and hamburger icon button that toggles visibility. Wrap desktop nav links in a hidden md:flex container. Create a full-width mobile dropdown menu (visible when isMenuOpen is true) containing all nav links and the 'Book a Free Call' CTA button stacked vertically. Ensure hamburger and all menu items have min-height/width of 44px for touch targets. Add onClick handlers to nav links that close the mobile menu after smooth-scrolling. Hide hamburger on md: breakpoint and above. Preserve dark backdrop blur aesthetic on mobile menu.

requirements.summary: Make Hero section fully responsive with scaled typography, vertically stacked CTAs on mobile, and disabled parallax on small screens
acceptanceCriteria: Headline font size is appropriately smaller on mobile (e.g., text-3xl or text-4xl vs text-6xl+ on desktop)
CTA buttons stack vertically on screens <640px and display side-by-side on larger screens
Parallax effect is disabled on mobile (useParallax hook or a media-query guard) to avoid layout issues
Hero section fills the viewport correctly on all screen sizes without horizontal overflow

file_operations.description: Apply responsive Tailwind classes to the headline (e.g., text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl), subheadline (text-base sm:text-lg md:text-xl), and tagline. Wrap the CTA button container with flex-col sm:flex-row to stack buttons vertically on mobile and side-by-side on larger screens. Conditionally disable the useParallax hook on mobile by checking window.innerWidth or using a media query hook; set translateY to 0 when disabled. Ensure the section has no horizontal overflow by verifying container max-width and padding.

requirements.summary: Make Services section fully responsive with 1/2/3 column grid layout and gracefully degraded scroll animations on mobile
acceptanceCriteria: Services grid shows 1 column on screens <640px
Services grid shows 2 columns on screens 640px–1023px
Services grid shows 3 columns on screens ≥1024px
Card text is fully readable without overflow on all breakpoints
Scroll-depth parallax animations are reduced or disabled on mobile

file_operations.description: Update the services grid container with responsive Tailwind classes: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. Ensure all card content (icon, title, description) has adequate padding and no text overflow. Reduce or disable the scroll-depth scale/translate animations on mobile by conditionally applying transform styles only on md: breakpoint and above, or by checking prefers-reduced-motion and viewport width before applying useScrollDepth-driven transforms.

requirements.summary: Make About section fully responsive with vertically stacked layout on mobile, 2-column stat grid, and disabled illustration parallax
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (<768px), illustration appears below the text content in a single-column stack
Stat counters are displayed in a 2-column grid on mobile and inline on desktop
Illustration parallax scroll effect is disabled on mobile
Section heading and body text scale to readable sizes on all breakpoints

file_operations.description: Refactor the split layout container to use flex-col md:flex-row so the illustration stacks below text on mobile. Update the stat counters container to use a grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 layout. Conditionally disable the parallax illustration scroll effect on mobile by wrapping the useParallax translateY application in a media query check or setting it to 0 on small screens. Apply responsive font size classes to the section heading (text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl) and body text (text-sm sm:text-base).

requirements.summary: Make Process section fully responsive with vertical stacking on mobile/tablet and horizontal timeline on desktop
acceptanceCriteria: On desktop (≥1024px), steps are displayed in a horizontal row with connector lines
On mobile and tablet (<1024px), steps stack vertically
Connector lines between steps are hidden in vertical/mobile layout
All step content is fully readable on all breakpoints
Scroll-triggered stagger animations trigger correctly on mobile

file_operations.description: Update the process steps container to use flex-col lg:flex-row for vertical stacking on mobile/tablet and horizontal layout on desktop. Conditionally render or hide the connector lines using the hidden lg:block utility class so they only appear in the horizontal desktop layout. Ensure step numbers, titles, and descriptions use responsive font sizes (text-base sm:text-lg for titles). Verify that the AnimationWrapper stagger delay works correctly on all breakpoints by testing scroll-triggered animations on mobile viewports.

requirements.summary: Make Testimonials section fully responsive with 1/2/3 column grid layout and no horizontal overflow
acceptanceCriteria: Testimonial cards display in 1 column on screens <640px
Testimonial cards display in 2 columns on screens 640px–1023px
Testimonial cards display in 3 columns on screens ≥1024px
No horizontal overflow on any breakpoint
All card text is legible on mobile

file_operations.description: Update the testimonials grid container with responsive Tailwind classes: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. Ensure all testimonial cards have appropriate padding and that quote text, author name, and company info use readable font sizes (text-sm sm:text-base for quotes). Verify no horizontal overflow by ensuring the grid container respects max-width constraints and has adequate horizontal padding (px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8).

requirements.summary: Make Contact section fully responsive with vertically stacked layout on mobile, full-width touch-friendly form fields, and 44px minimum button height
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (<768px), the info panel stacks above the form in a single column
On desktop (≥768px), the info panel and form display side by side
Form inputs are full-width on mobile with adequate padding for touch interaction
Submit button height is at least 44px on mobile
Phone (tel:) and email (mailto:) links remain clickable and visible on all breakpoints

file_operations.description: Refactor the contact section layout container to use flex-col md:flex-row so the info panel stacks above the form on mobile. Ensure all form inputs (Name, Email, Company, Message) are full-width with adequate padding (py-3 px-4) for touch interaction. Set the submit button to have a minimum height of 44px (h-11 or h-12) and full-width on mobile (w-full md:w-auto). Verify phone and email links in the info panel remain visible and clickable with adequate tap target sizes on all breakpoints.

requirements.summary: Make Footer fully responsive with vertically stacked columns on mobile, multi-column layout on desktop, and 44×44px social icon tap targets
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (<640px), all footer columns stack vertically
On desktop (≥768px), footer displays in a multi-column horizontal layout
Social media icon tap targets are at least 44×44px on mobile
All footer text (brand name, tagline, links, contact details, copyright) is legible on mobile
No horizontal scroll or content overflow on mobile

file_operations.description: Refactor the footer layout container to use flex-col sm:flex-row or a responsive grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4) so columns stack vertically on mobile and display horizontally on desktop. Ensure social media icons have minimum width and height of 44px (w-11 h-11) with adequate touch padding. Apply responsive font sizes to all footer text (text-xs sm:text-sm for body text, text-sm sm:text-base for headings). Verify no horizontal overflow by checking container padding and max-width constraints.

requirements.summary: Apply global responsive typography and spacing adjustments, ensure no horizontal overflow, and verify ScrollProgressBar on mobile
acceptanceCriteria: Section vertical padding is smaller on mobile (e.g., py-12 on mobile vs py-24 on desktop)
No horizontal scroll bar appears on mobile at any viewport width from 320px upward
The ScrollProgressBar is visible and functions correctly on mobile
Body text is at least 14px on mobile for readability
All AnimationWrapper scroll-reveal animations trigger correctly on mobile viewports

file_operations.description: Apply responsive vertical padding to all section wrappers (py-12 sm:py-16 md:py-20 lg:py-24). Add overflow-x-hidden to the root container (likely a div wrapping all sections or on the body via index.css) to prevent horizontal scroll. Verify the ScrollProgressBar component remains fixed and visible on mobile by checking its z-index and position styles. Ensure all sections respect container max-width and horizontal padding constraints to prevent overflow.

Add overflow-x: hidden to the html or body selector to enforce no horizontal scroll globally. Review and adjust base font size to ensure body text is at least 14px (0.875rem) on mobile. Verify that all custom utility classes (gradients, glows) do not cause layout overflow. Ensure prefers-reduced-motion media query is respected for all scroll-triggered animations.

Verify that the IntersectionObserver threshold and root margin settings work correctly on mobile viewports (320px and up). Ensure scroll-reveal animations trigger at appropriate scroll positions on small screens. Confirm prefers-reduced-motion handling disables or reduces animations on mobile when the user preference is set.
